ph_sensitivity_note: Ambroxol's own directional sanity check passes (positive neutral-minus-acidic CNNaffinity delta), but this does not by itself validate the pH-sensitivity endpoint: only 0/3 of the other controls (isofagomine, P9V, P8Y) agree, and only 3/6 interpretable candidates favor the neutral state. Status is reported as 'exploratory_unvalidated': these score differences may inform exploratory prioritization but do not establish pH-dependent binding, lysosomal release, or pharmacological-chaperone behavior. The primary neutral-state structural-proxy endpoint is unaffected and remains the frozen primary result.
